conventions.ulp: bf16 ulp of the OFF top-1 logit = 2^(floor(log2|x|)-7) (dd_logits_step.bf16_ulp)
conventions.flip_model: flip iff margin_off + delta_pair < 0, or == 0 and off_top2 < off_top1 (lowest id wins ties)
conventions.prediction: P(flip_k) = P(d < -m_k) + [off_top2 < off_top1] P(d == -m_k), d drawn from the empirical delta_pair set; flip count = Poisson-binomial over steps
